programme.desc: En Inglaterra, Cody Banks se hace pasar por un prodigio de la música para frustrar los planes de un agente malvado que quiere dominar el mundo con un dispositivo controlador de mentes.

programme.title: Un perro de otro mundo
programme.desc: Owen Baker, de 12 años, es un amante de los perros que se emociona cuando finalmente adopta a su propio perro del refugio de animales. Para su asombro, pronto se entera de que su nueva mascota, a la que llama Hubble, no es un perro cualquiera.

programme.title: Max
programme.desc: Un perro que ayudó a los soldados en Afganistán vuelve a los EUA, donde lo adopta la familia de su adiestrador tras sufrir una experiencia traumática.

programme.title: El legado
programme.desc: Un exconvicto recientemente liberado y su hermano menor adoptivo se ven obligados a huir. Perseguidos por un criminal vengativo, los federales y un grupo de soldados de otro mundo, su única protección es un arma encontrada de ascendencia misteriosa.

programme.title: El monje
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat y Seann William Scott protagonizan esta gran aventura, en la que un misterioso monje tibetano, quien ha protejido un pergamino por 60 años; cree que ha encontrado a su sucesor: un joven callejero.

programme.title: Rescate al alba
programme.desc: Durante la guerra de Vietnam, el piloto americano, Dieter Dengler (Christian Bale) es derribado y tomado prisionero por el Vietcong. Durante su cautiverio, le tocó vivir una de las experiencias más notables y horrorosas de toda la guerra.

programme.title: Las momias de Guanajuato
programme.desc: Las momias de Guanajuato se han levantado y Leo San Juan, Don Andrés, Teodora y el Alebrije deben detenerlos, todo mientras rescatan a su amiga Xóchil y descubren el misterio.

programme.title: La leyenda del Chupacabras
programme.desc: Siguiendo la tradición aterradora y divertida de SCOOBY DOO y GOOSEBUMPS, llega esta aventura animada sobre un niño heroico y algunos amigos mágicos que descubren el misterio de un monstruo legendario.

programme.title: Candela
programme.desc: Bea es una adolescente inmadura que vive con su madre. Cuando aparece una niña llamada Candela, la vida de Bea cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: El caballero de las sombras
programme.desc: Pu Songling, un legendario cazador de demonios, debe investigar las misteriosas desapariciones de niñas en un pequeño pueblo. Cuando descubre las fuerzas del mal, trata de salvar a la humanidad en esta fantástica comedia de artes marciales y acción.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Un profesor de arqueología conocido mundialmente y su equipo deben localizar y salvar un antiguo tesoro perdido, antes que un equipo de mercenarios lo destruyan para siempre.

programme.title: Liga de Kung Fu
programme.desc: Cuando el jefe de Fei Ying Xiong le impide conseguir la chica de sus sueños, este pide ayuda a cuatro legendarios maestros de Kung Fu para aprender el máximo nivel de artes marciales y derrotar a sus enemigos.

programme.title: La leyenda del gato demoniaco
programme.desc: Un poeta y un monje investigan a un gato demoniaco que ha poseído a la esposa de un general de la corte imperial. La investigación los conducirá al misterio que se esconde tras la muerte de una legendaria y bella cortesana.

programme.title: Max Cloud (ESP)
programme.desc: Cuando la pequeña Sarah abre un portal a su juego favorito de desplazamiento lateral, queda atrapada en una prisión intergaláctica, hogar de los villanos más peligrosos de la galaxia.

programme.title: El encuentro
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos encuentran un ovni estrellado con solo un extraterrestre y descubren que el ser tiene grandes secretos de lo que pueden entender.

programme.title: Mega tornado
programme.desc: Los tornados de A.I. son liberados en el Reino Unido, causando caos y muerte a cada paso.

programme.title: Los siete sellos del apocalipsis
programme.desc: En esta película épica de desastres y fe, una madre y un padre buscan desesperadamente a su único hijo, mientras que un asteroide gigante que se dirige a la Tierra desencadena una serie de eventos apocalípticos.

programme.title: La familia Monster
programme.desc: Después de que Emma Wishbone lleva a su familia a una fiesta de disfraces en la noche de Halloween, todos están malditos por una bruja y se convierten en monstruos.

programme.title: Pie Grande
programme.desc: Después de chocar su bicicleta en el bosque, Percy Caldwell se encuentra con un nuevo amigo, Bigfoot, una criatura de dos metros y medio de altura, que ha sido desplazada por un reciente incendio forestal.

programme.title: Tesoro escondido del Mississippi
programme.desc: Dos niños son testigos de un asesinato pero deciden no contárselo a nadie por miedo.

programme.title: Atrapados: enterrados vivos
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Jack Wagner, Gabrielle Carteris y Mark Lindsay Chapman. Michael Cooper (Wagner) emprende una arriesgada misión de rescate para salvar a su mujer, a su hija y a los demás ocupantes de un albergue de ski que han sido atrapados.

programme.title: Locos por los caballos
programme.desc: Tres niños que sueñan con atrapar su propio caballo salvaje burlan a un grupo de ladrones de caballos y devuelven un caballo premiado a su dueño.

programme.title: Escuela de la vida
programme.desc: Un nuevo maestro se enfrenta a su malhumorado competidor por el premio al maestro del año.

programme.title: California Dreaming (ESP)
programme.desc: Una familia de Omaha decide tomar las vacaciones de sus sueños en una casa móvil rumbo a California, sin imaginarse que sus peores pesadillas están a punto de comenzar.

programme.title: 16-Love
programme.desc: Ally “Smash” Mash, de 16 años, vive entre las líneas blancas cuidadosamente pintadas del tenis juvenil.

programme.title: Griff el Invisible
programme.desc: Ryan Kwanten, la estrella de True Blood, interpreta a un tímido oficinista cuya heroica identidad secreta se ve amenazada por una joven peculiar.

programme.title: Khumba
programme.desc: Rechazado por su rebaño supersticioso, una cebra a media raya se embarca en una atrevida búsqueda para ganarse sus rayas, pero encuentra el valor y la aceptación para salvar a todos los animales del gran Karoo.

programme.title: Isla Dinosaurio
programme.desc: Un niño y una niña se encuentran atrapados en una tierra misteriosa. Juntos, se embarcan en el mágico viaje de regreso a casa y se encuentran con nativos tribales, feroces dinosaurios y una tierra olvidada desde hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: La cueva encantada
programme.desc: La película cuenta una historia sobre la esperanza, pero también sobre la codicia humana. Un emocionante cuento de hadas lleno de suspense arrastra al espectador a las profundidades de una misteriosa cueva hasta que no quiere salir a la superficie.

programme.title: Un amable fantasma
programme.desc: La historia, basada en el cuento de Hans Christian Andersen El polvorín. Voita adquiere un polvorín de oro con el que puede conjurar al fantasma y pedirle que cumpla tres deseos.

programme.title: Edhel
programme.desc: Edhel tiene una malformación en las orejas que parecen las de un elfo. Afronta su malestar evitando relacionarse con la gente. El encuentro con un extraño conserje de la escuela convence a la niña de pertenecer a la noble línea de los Elfos.

programme.title: Perro de Hollywood
programme.desc: Murphy ("Just Jesse the Jack") es una estrella de televisión canina mega famosa que está harta de que los ejecutivos de Hollywood la traten como una "máquina de dinero".

programme.title: El hechizo del tren
programme.desc: Cuando dos adolescentes encienden el interruptor de un tren en miniatura, sucede algo misterioso: ¡se reducen a figuras en miniatura y se encuentran dentro del tren a toda velocidad!

programme.title: Una milla en sus pies
programme.desc: Murph es un entrenador de béisbol y está en busca de nuevo talento para su liga de menores. Descubre a Mickey quien sufre del Síndrome de Asperger y quien es un lanzador increíble.

programme.title: Diamantes negros
programme.desc: Amadou y Moussa son descubiertos en Malí por un ojeador de fútbol, separados de sus familias para convertirse en estrellas del balompié. Emprenden un viaje que les mostrará el mundo de sombras que se esconde tras el deporte rey.

programme.title: Los campeones
programme.desc: Cinco historias reales de victorias de atletas rusos. Todas las victorias son historias humanas, donde el amor, la traición, la amistad, el respeto, el trabajo y la fe se entrelazan en una sola. Historias sobre creer en uno mismo, creer en la victoria.

programme.title: Dios no hace las leyes
programme.desc: La pequeña ciudad de Rockwell está misteriosamente congelada en el tiempo después de un accidente de autobús, es decir, hasta que un niño con un pasado sórdido llega a la ciudad y luego las manecillas del tiempo avanzan.

programme.title: Askari
programme.desc: Mientras tanto, Emma, una huérfana de 16 años, se esfuerza por adaptarse a la vida en una reserva de animales en África dirigida por sus tíos, ella desarrolla un fuerte vínculo con uno de los elefantes recién nacidos.

programme.title: Fondo de fideicomiso
programme.desc: Reese Donahue lleva una vida aparentemente ideal, con un futuro brillante por delante. Pero cuando descubre la verdad, que su madre le dejó suficiente dinero para que ella eligiera su propio camino, se enfrenta a un dilema.

programme.title: Tornado Texano
programme.desc: Un hombre comienza a tener visiones de un tornado destructivo después de la muerte de su hijo.

programme.title: Abismo estelar
programme.desc: Una nave espacial que viaja a través de Stargates queda atrapada en el Abismo de las Estrellas. Con solo 4 de los 15 pasajeros capaces de usar cápsulas de hibernación, uno de ellos libera un monstruo alienígena para aumentar sus probabilidades.

programme.title: Lluvia solar
programme.desc: Trevor y su colega científico Nick descubren que el sol ha sido empujado hacia la Tierra, causando todo tipo de desastres relacionados con el fuego a medida que el planeta comienza a calentarse rápidamente.

programme.title: Una osa llamada Winnie
programme.desc: La extraordinaria historia real del oso negro que se convertiría en la inspiración para las historias de A.A. Milne, y el hombre heroico que le salvó la vida.

programme.title: Cuarenta noches
programme.desc: "Cuarenta noches" es una historia profunda sobre una de las figuras más conocidas, cuestionadas y misteriosas de la historia de la humanidad.

programme.title: Tormenta terrestre
programme.desc: Un asteroide galpea el lado oscura de la luna, desencadenando cambios climáticos en la tierra.

programme.title: Orgullo sobre hielo
programme.desc: Una joven campeona de patinaje deja el deporte tras una mudanza familiar. Con ayuda del dueño de una pista de hielo, descubre su verdadero potencial.

programme.title: Aventuras en Dinotopia
programme.desc: David Scott y su hermano Karl se encuentran en la aventura de su vida cuando se encuentran atrapados en Dinotopia.

programme.title: Naturaleza desatada: terremoto
programme.desc: La familia de un ingeniero está en el camino directo del peligro después de que un temblor masivo dañe gravemente una planta nuclear rusa.

programme.title: Little Italy
programme.desc: The director of How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days and Miss Congeniality cooks up a sizzling comedy about two lifelong pals whose romance is threatened by their families' rival pizzerias.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: After arriving at New York's JFK airport, Viktor Navorski gets unwittingly caught in bureaucratic glitches that make it impossible for him to return to his home country or enter the U.S.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: The Ex
programme.desc: After getting fired, a man winds up working for his wife's father while she takes care of the baby.

programme.title: The Truth About Love
programme.desc: As part of a drunken bet with her sister, a happily married woman sends an anonymous Valentine's card to her husband to see if he hides it. When he does, what was a prank leads to a series of events and revelations that puts her marriage at risk.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: A single woman focused on her career in New York is forced to deal with the aftermath of a failed relationship when an ex-boyfriend hires her company.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs Lie
programme.desc: A woman finds her relationship in chaos after admitting an embarrasing sexual encounter from her past.

programme.title: Making Babies
programme.desc: A couple puts their marriage to the ultimate test in an effort to have a child.

programme.title: You, Me, and Him
programme.desc: In You, Me and Him we meet lesbian couple Olivia and Alex (Lucy Punch, Faye Marsay) who, despite their age difference, are very much in love.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Two guys who make a pact to lose their virginity before prom find their friendship tested when one of them comes out of the closet.

programme.title: Down To You
programme.desc: From the moment they meet amid the chaos of college in New York City, Al (Freddie Prinze Jr.) and Imogen (Julia Stiles) begin a romantic journey where true love often competes with the temptation to stray from commitment.

programme.title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
programme.desc: Diane Keaton, Jeremy Irons, and Maggie Grace lead this warmhearted romantic comedy that follows a colorful cast of characters searching for love against the backdrop of a wedding.

programme.title: Carolina
programme.desc: Julia Stiles and Oscar winner Shirley MacLaine headline this charming romantic comedy in which a young woman tries to escape the eccentric ways of her wacky Southern family and meet the man of her dreams.

programme.title: The Triumph Of Love
programme.desc: A Princess has fallen head over heels in love with her sworn enemy, Agis, the rightful heir to her kingdom. Driven into exile, Agis now lives with a philosopher and his spinster sister who have taught Agis to hate the Princess.

programme.title: A Royal Night Out
programme.desc: On V.E. Day in 1945, as peace extends across Europe, Princesses Elizabeth and Margaret are allowed out to join the celebrations. It is a night full of excitement, danger and the first flutters of romance.

programme.title: Night Owls
programme.desc: Workaholic Kevin goes home with the beautiful trainwreck Madeline for a drunken one night stand, but he's horrified to discover she's actually his boss' ex-mistress. After she takes a bottle of sleeping pills, Kevin is forced to keep her awake all night.

programme.title: Dr. T and The Women
programme.desc: A wealthy gynecologist finds his perfect life turned upside down by a series of family dramas.

programme.title: It Had To Be You
programme.desc: Surprised by a sudden proposal and subsequent ultimatum from her boyfriend, Sonia embarks on a bumpy, raunchy journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Anything Else
programme.desc: As Amanda's and Jerry's relationship flounders and her mom's noisy presence makes writing difficult for him, he and David plan something different. Wouldn't anything else be better?

programme.title: The Rebound
programme.desc: Sandy, upon discovering her husband's infidelity while watching her son's birthday video, leaves the suburbs and moves into the city.

programme.title: Blind Dating
programme.desc: A blind young man (Pine) thinks he finds love with an Indian woman (Jay), though their relationship is fraught with cultural differences.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: Music-obsessed misfits (Aly Michalka, Vanessa Hudgens, Gaelan Connell) cope with high school life by forming a band for the big Bandslam competition.

programme.title: Karma Calling
programme.desc: Call centers, Hindu hip-hop, and busybody aunties are toppings for this extra large slice of the immigrant story. The moral: Don't hang up on that call center operator. Karma is calling.

programme.title: Sleeping With Other People
programme.desc: Alison Brie and Jason Sudeikis star in this hilariously heartfelt romantic comedy about two serial cheaters who get a second chance at love.

programme.title: 7 Days
programme.desc: Set-up on a pre-arranged date, Ravi and Rita seemingly have nothing in common. The situation turns both awkward and enlightening when they find themselves trapped inside together for a week.

programme.title: Not Suitable for Children
programme.desc: A womanizer learns he has one month before he becomes sterile, so he tries to impregnate a woman before it's too late.

programme.title: The Other End Of The Line
programme.desc: An employee at an Indian call-center travels to San Francisco to be with a guy she falls for over the phone.

programme.title: Chalet Girl
programme.desc: Brooke Shields & Ed Westwick star in this enchanting comedy about a pretty girl (Felicity Jones) who discovers love and snowboarding at an exclusive winter resort.

programme.title: Dorfman in Love
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about Deb Dorfman, who is uprooted from the comfort of the suburban San Fernando Valley and caught up in the whirlwind of revitalized downtown LA.

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Love, Rosie is a heart-warming, modern comedy-of-errors about Rosie and Alex. As each navigates the complexities of life, love, and everything in between, they always find their way back to each other - but is it just friendship, or something more?

programme.title: About Alex
programme.desc: Crushes and rivalries are rekindled when college friends reunite for a lake house weekend. With Aubrey Plaza.

programme.title: Weekend
programme.desc: A drunken one-night stand turns into a deeper romance over the course of a booze, drug and sex filled weekend.

programme.title: Below Her Mouth
programme.desc: An unexpected affair quickly escalates into a heart-stopping reality for two women whose passionate connection changes their lives forever.

programme.title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
programme.desc: Based on the celebrated novel by Emily M. Danforth, this film follows the titular character (Chloë Grace Moretz) as she is sent to a gay conversion therapy center after getting caught with another girl in the back seat of a car on prom night.

programme.title: De-lovely
programme.desc: Biography of composer and songwriter Cole Porter, a kid from Indiana who became a legend. The focus is how Porter, a gay man, found his inspiration from the woman he married, socialite Linda Lee Porter. Features some of the composer's most famous music.

programme.title: The Imposters
programme.desc: Maya splits with her long-term girlfriend and meets the enigmatic Hattie but everything is not as it seems.

programme.title: All Over the Guy
programme.desc: While the flame of Jackie and Brett's attraction intensifies, Eli and Tom, the unlikely pair they attempt to bring together, appear destined to spiral out of love rather than make any sort of progress toward becoming a genuine couple.

programme.title: The Duke of Burgundy
programme.desc: Two women take their carnal desires to the extreme in this kinky, deliciously twisted tale of sex and butterflies.

programme.title: Blue is the Warmest Color
programme.desc: A highly erotic film about two women in love.

programme.title: The Feels
programme.desc: Andi (Constance Wu) and Lu (Angela Trimbur) are excited to celebrate their upcoming wedding with a joint bachelorette weekend in wine country. On the first night, things go awry when one of the brides admits she's never had an orgasm.

programme.title: Becks
programme.desc: After a crushing breakup with her girlfriend, a Brooklyn musician moves back in with her Midwestern mother. As she navigates her hometown, playing for tip money in an old friend's bar, an unexpected relationship begins to take shape.

programme.title: Queerama
programme.desc: Compilation of archive footage from 1919 to the present, from both documentary and fictional sources, set to music, illustrating the huge changes in LGBTQ life in Britain (mainly England) over the 20th century.

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: To save his family's shoe business from imminent bankruptcy, young Charlie Price turns to an unlikely new creative consultant: a fabulous drag queen whose creative style and wild designs are a breath of fresh air in the stuffy old factory.

programme.title: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Commitment-phobic Morgan and her ex-girlfriend Jean are locally famous true crime podcasters who suspect Morgan's new love interest is a murderer.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Inspired by Michelangelo Antonioni's 1961 classic L'Avventura, Michael Akers' "PHOENIX" is infused with symbolism and a sexy spark.

programme.title: Hauntology
programme.desc: An older sister takes her runaway sibling on a road trip, to share the most chilling tales surrounding their hometown.

programme.title: The Event
programme.desc: An intense relationship drama that takes the form of a mystery, The Event centers around a series of unexplained deaths that occur among the gay community in New York's fashionable Chelsea district.

programme.title: Unicorns
programme.desc: A single father falls for a closeted drag performer who will do anything to keep his double life hidden from his traditional Indian Muslim family. Unicorns is the story of the transformative power of being seen for who you really are.

programme.title: Romeo and Isabella
programme.desc: Trans woman, Isabella, has struggled to find the right man. When she goes back home, old friends and skeletons come back to find her.

programme.title: Disobedience
programme.desc: A woman (Rachel Weisz) returns to her Orthodox Jewish community after the death of her rabbi father and stirs up controversy when she shows an interest in an old childhood friend (Rachel McAdams).

programme.title: The Pass
programme.desc: Jason and Ade are nineteen. They’ve been in the academy of a famous London soccer club since they were eight, and now it’s the night before their first-ever game as professionals. They should be sleeping, but they’re over-excited.

programme.title: John Apple Jack
programme.desc: When playboy John (Chris McNally) discovers his sister's fiancé is childhood crush Jack (Kent S. Leung), passions ignite and his life spirals out of control. Losing his job, reputation and underwear, John ventures to find a better recipe for life.

programme.title: Confessions of a Gay Poet
programme.desc: Explore a life's journey of love and loss, triumph and tragedy with LGBT rising star Wade Radford (Twink, 1 Last Chance at Paradise). Deeply personal, inspiring and moving, enjoy this candid, poetic exposé into a complex soul.

programme.title: The Rainbow Bridge Motel
programme.desc: After reserving an all-inclusive wedding package at Niagara Falls, Dean & Darren learn they’ve booked themselves in a run-down motor lodge sandwiched between two chemical plants run by some guy named Shibbawitz and a Burmese refugee family.

programme.title: With a Kiss I Die
programme.desc: Centuries after Romeo’s death, Juliet Capulet falls in love with a young woman and is once again forced to choose between love and family obligation, terrified her past mistakes will once again lead to tragedy.

programme.title: House of Boys
programme.desc: Two young soul mates find each other while working at an all-male performance club/brothel. Eventually, one contracts AIDS.

programme.title: Pride & Groom
programme.desc: Celebrating one year of marriage equality in New York, this docu-style special follows an engaged Upstate couple on their journey to wedded bliss.

programme.title: Framing Agnes
programme.desc: The story of the pioneering transgender woman who participated in an infamous gender study conducted at UCLA in the 1960s.

programme.title: Saturday Church
programme.desc: A 14 year-old-boy, struggling with gender identity and religion, begins to use fantasy to escape his life in the inner city and find his passion in the process.

programme.title: Truth
programme.desc: A suspenseful, psychological thriller, "Truth" exposes the hidden demons buried deep inside each and every one of us.

programme.title: Walk With Me
programme.desc: Young mother Amber Evans is forced to start over after she builds up the courage to leave her husband and her life. It explores what it means to be a woman and shows how we embrace and reject who we are. How we stand tall in our own shoes.

programme.title: Bristol Fashion
programme.desc: Christina is a young trans woman who's running: from her past and home. When she buys a broken-down boat to flee, she meets Esteban. He gives her a place to stay on an abandoned barge and slowly they find themselves meaning something to each other.

programme.title: Matt Shepard Is A Friend of Mine
programme.desc: Matt Shepard is a Friend of Mine is a powerful feature documentary about Matthew Shepard, the gay young man who was tortured and murdered in one of the most notorious hate crimes in U.S. history.

programme.title: Will You Still Love Me Tomorrow?
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, shy Weichung begins to question his marriage and sexuality after bumping into an old friend who’s living the life of a younger, single gay man.

programme.title: Appropriate Behavior
programme.desc: For Shirin, being part of a perfect Persian family isn't easy. Acceptance eludes her from all sides: her family doesn't know she's bisexual, and her ex-girlfriend, Maxine, can't understand why she doesn't tell them.

programme.title: My Fiona
programme.desc: In the wake of Fiona's suicide, her widow and her best friend form a relationship bound by grief that threatens the healing of all involved.

programme.title: Tell Me I Love You
programme.desc: Three best friends and ex-lovers hatch a plan to get married and inherit money to make a hit album. But new lovers, old flames, and their parents have other ideas for them as they discover that family is actually who you choose.

programme.title: 1 Million Happy Nows
programme.desc: The story of Lainey and Eva’s changing relationship as they struggle to deal with the diagnosis of Lainey’s Early Onset Alzheimer’s.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: Martin and Eugenio, two former childhood friends, reunite during a hot summer in the Argentinean countryside. As they work to restore Eugenio's summer home, a game of power and desire ensues forcing the two to grapple with their sexual attraction.

programme.title: The Amazing Truth About Queen Raquela
programme.desc: Raquela, a Filipino transsexual prostitute, dreams of moving to Paris and escaping her lifestyle. To make her wishes come true, she starts working in Internet porn where she quickly becomes a star.

programme.title: Ava's Impossible Things
programme.desc: Marina Rice Bader (Anatomy of a Love Seen) invites us into a world that is equal parts fantasy and reality. It's been 3 years since Ava put her future on hold, moving back home to care for her mother.

programme.title: 4th Man Out
programme.desc: Adam, a small-town mechanic, decides it’s time to tell his friends and family he’s gay. Will his straight-as-an-arrow best bros have his back? A lighthearted and unexpectedly subversive comedy about coming out of the blue-collar closet.

programme.title: Playdurizm
programme.desc: A teenager finds himself caught in a glitchy-glitzy reality with his on-screen male idol.

programme.title: Caught in a Landslide
programme.desc: Jay's resident ghost appears nightly, conjuring up visions of a lost summer romance; taunting him with the opportunity to speak words previously unspoken that slowly begin to heal his broken heart and release him from darkness.

programme.title: Here Together
programme.desc: Where did you meet the love of your life? At the supermarket? On a hiking trail? Here Together gathers gay couples to tell the stories of meeting and falling in love.

programme.title: Running on Empty Dreams
programme.desc: Sydney has played the part of a devoted wife to her husband for years, but her world is shattered when she meets Jane and is instantly attracted to her. Sydney is faced with a choice between the forbidden love and the undying love of her husband.

programme.title: The Ice King
programme.desc: John Curry transformed ice skating from a dated sport into a new artistic medium. Coming out on the night of his Olympic win in 1976, he became the first openly gay Olympian in a time when homosexuality was not even fully legal.

programme.title: A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: Chelsea helps Leny overcome his life from a down-spin as his reality comes crashing down after discovering his wife in bed with another woman.

programme.title: Bridegroom
programme.desc: Shane Bitney Crone's plans to marry Tom Bridegroom in California after the same-sex marriage law is passed takes a tragic turn when his partner of six years accidentally dies and Tom's family refuses Shane from attending the funeral.

programme.title: Light in the Water
programme.desc: In 1982 soon after the first Gay Games, West Hollywood Aquatics registered as the first openly gay masters swim team in the world. This athletic powerhouse fought injustice in the world of competitive sports, and ultimately became a family.

programme.title: A Year of Pride with Taylor Barrett
programme.desc: Actress, filmmaker, and comedian Taylor Barrett takes a look back at a monumental year of LGBT pride. Join Taylor as she conducts interviews and provides insight into the passing of Marriage Equality, LGBT acceptance, and what's next on the agenda.

programme.title: Giant Little Ones
programme.desc: Two best friends live a perfect teenage life – until they are involved in an unexpected incident with each other that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: The Mattachine Family
programme.desc: When their foster son is reunited with his mom, Thomas and Oscar diverge as they grapple with life after fatherhood. As Oscar's career takes off, Thomas embarks on a personal journey to find the meaning of family.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: NINA is an LGBTQ debut feature, painting a sensitive portrait of a strong yet confused woman trapped in her role as a wife and daughter.

programme.title: Something You Said Last Night
programme.desc: After being fired from her job, Ren joins her family on vacation. The realities of being a stunted millennial and a trans woman coalesce as Ren struggles to balance yearning for independence with the comfort of being taken care of.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: A teenage boy discovers that his father is gay.

programme.title: After Louie
programme.desc: After Louie follows Sam (Tony Award® winner Alan Cumming), an artist and activist from ACT UP who lived through the early years of HIV/AIDS — a man scarred and still struggling with survivor's guilt. Cemented into an oppressive past.

programme.title: One Four Three
programme.desc: A woman diagnosed with amnesia struggles to remember her attacker, her lover, and herself.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Love Seen
programme.desc: From Writer/Director Marina Rice Bader (Executive Producer Elena Undone, A Perfect Ending) comes this film within a film that explores love in all its painful and messy glory.

programme.title: Dark Beacon
programme.desc: An abandoned paramour tracks her lover down to a distant lighthouse. When she finds her beyond hope she must find a way to save a child from the malignant spirit of her deceased father and the madness of her mother.

programme.title: Love and Videotapes
programme.desc: In the summer of 2001, in a small town in the Philippines, 16-year-old Andoy searches for his long-lost father in the most unlikely of places: VHS tapes. Together with his best friend and fellow movie nerd Pido, he explores life on film.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam and Tusker are traveling across England in their old RV to visit friends, family and places from their past. Since Tusker was diagnosed with dementia two years ago, their time together is the most important thing they have.

programme.title: Truman & Tennessee
programme.desc: This documentary explores Truman Capote and Tennessee Williams' lives, work, and friendship, blending archival footage, iconic film clips, and voiceovers by Jim Parsons and Zachary Quinto to celebrate their art, wit, and lasting cultural impact.

programme.title: Pacto de amor
programme.desc: El Rey de Navarra y sus mejores amigos renuncian al amor, para dedicarse a la iluminación intelectual; pero con la visita de la Princesa de Francia y sus hermosas asistentes, sus juramentos tambalean.

programme.title: Volando Alto
programme.desc: Gwyneth Paltrow protagoniza en esta comedia hilarante sobre una chica de pueblo con grandes planes. Cuando se propone ser azafata internacional de primera clase, Donna se arriesga y sale a perseguir su sueño.

programme.title: Cheri
programme.desc: A una famosa cortesana de ricos y famosos en el París previo a la Primera Guerra Mundial se le pide que enseñe a un niño de 19 años. La aventura que se convierte en un acalorado y apasionado asunto que resulta en luchas de poder y luchas por amor.

programme.title: About Adam
programme.desc: Cuando la despreocupada Lucy (Kate Hudson) al fin conoce a su hombre perfecto, Adam (Stuart Townsend), está lista para sentar cabeza de verdad. Pero mientras Lucy está ocupada planeando la boda, Adam está ocupado ¡encantando al resto de su familia!

programme.title: Prueba de amor
programme.desc: Desde que se conocen en medio del caos de la universidad en Nueva York, Al (Freddie Prinze Jr.) e Imogen (Julia Stiles) comienzan una aventura romántica en la que el amor verdadero a veces compite con la tentación de alejarse del compromiso.

programme.title: Amor a fuego lento
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, un famoso chef regresa de mala gana a su pequeño pueblo natal. Allí redescubre su pasión por la cocina y se reencuentra con un antiguo amor que está a punto de casarse.

programme.title: Aire Libre
programme.desc: Una pareja de treintañeros que lucha con la vida, el matrimonio, el trabajo, un hijo y una casa recién comprada en las afueras de la ciudad.

programme.title: El que busca encuentra
programme.desc: Esperanza y Marcos son dos personas que creen en el destino y en el amor verdadero.

programme.title: Amor letra por letra
programme.desc: Recién despedida, Hanna deposita por accidente su último cheque en la cuenta de banco de Edgar, un aspirante a escritor. Hanna se dispone a encontrar a Edgar, quien ya comenzó a gastar el dinero.

programme.title: De Prada a la nada
programme.desc: Nora y Mary son hermanas mimadas que viven la buena vida en Beverly Hills hasta que su amoroso padre muere inesperadamente.

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un magnate automotriz ve derrumbarse su vida personal y profesional por sus indiscreciones amorosas y de negocios.

programme.title: Bella

programme.title: El cuento de las comadrejas

programme.title: Para entrar a vivir
programme.desc: Ana y Maxi son una pareja de treintañeros que acaban de encontrar la casa de sus sueños. Todo es perfecto hasta que se dan cuenta de que es aún mejor: la casa les da todo lo que piden.

programme.title: Descalza

programme.title: Loco Love
programme.desc: Un hombre que pierde su riqueza acepta casarse con la hermana de un jardinero, quien acaba de ganar la lotería.

programme.title: La mujer de mi hermano

programme.title: En otro lugar
programme.desc: Pedro y Luis encuentran el amor en el norte de España después de una serie de aventuras inesperadas.

programme.title: La luz incidente
programme.desc: Una mujer joven que tiene problemas al criar a sus hijas gemelas después de que su marido y su hermano mueren, acepta el cortejo de un pretendiente encantador pero misterioso, mayor que ella.

programme.title: Amo la cocina
programme.desc: Después de una mala crítica de un crítico y una charla del chef Gordon Ramsay, un talentoso pero afligido chef londinense convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet.

programme.title: La belleza de la vida
programme.desc: Una joven con sueños de convertirse en autora de libros para niños forma una inesperada amistad con un malhumorado y adinerado viudo. Juntos, descubrirán que la vida tiene mucho más que ofrecer cuando se abren al otro y dejan atrás los prejuicios del pasado.

programme.title: Suficiente coraje
programme.desc: Un hombre exiliado en Venezuela vuelve a Chile para vengar la muerte de su padre, asesinado durante la dictadura militar de los setenta. En su búsqueda del hombre que ordenó la muerte de sus padres, conoce a una mujer que escapa de la crisis política.

programme.title: Camino a la fama
programme.desc: Tres ángeles le dan el don del canto a una niña y una serie de reglas a seguir para su fama y fortuna.

programme.title: Solteras indisponibles
programme.desc: Tres niñas pequeñas, mejores amigas, conocen a un hechicero que les concede un deseo: tener la misma suerte en el amor. Varios años después, cada una de ellas tiene su propia vida hasta que un día un evento inesperado cambia sus destinos

programme.title: Andrea y Lorenzo

programme.title: Una boda complicada

programme.title: Amanecer en el cielo
programme.desc: Una pareja joven debe convencer a su padre estricto de su verdadero amor. La película corta entre la década de 1950, donde floreció su amor, y la actualidad, cuando su amor completa el círculo.

programme.title: Solo una vez
programme.desc: Cuando la prometida de un bombero accede a regañadientes a participar en un trío con otra mujer, lo hace con la condición de que él le corresponda el favor con otro hombre.

programme.title: Un romance escurridizo
programme.desc: Una estrella de reality shows deja Hollywood y se encuentra en una comunidad Amish, donde debe decidir entre permanecer en su nueva realidad o regresar a la anterior.

programme.title: En busca del amor
programme.desc: Cuando el canal de televisión anuncia que su programa de terapia se está convirtiendo en una fiesta sensacionalista, una psicóloga cariñosa y sincera decide regresar a su ciudad natal y se reúne con su novio de la escuela secundaria.

programme.title: El sabor del amor
programme.desc: Alice, una joven y talentosa sous chef del mejor restaurante de Nueva York, recibe una invitación para ser jueza de un concurso de comida para una prestigiosa recaudación de fondos anual.

programme.title: Encontrando el amor en San Antonio
programme.desc: Adela Romero, una exitosa chef televisiva que vive en Los Ángeles, acaba de terminar la nueva temporada de su programa.

programme.title: Stockholm
programme.desc: It starts with a guy trying to get a girl he met at a party to like him. She refuses but he doesn't give up and the story continues in a long and interesting conversation between them during which he manages to gain her attention.

programme.title: Encuentra el amor en Charm, Ohio

programme.title: Super familia

programme.title: Por amor al money

programme.title: Un macho de mujer
programme.desc: Ramón, después de trabajar, no tiene reparos en irse de parranda, provocando el hartazgo de su esposa. Un día un personaje enigmático le regala un amuleto que ocasiona un hechizo intercambiando los roles familiares de ambos.

programme.title: The Boy Downstairs (ESP)
programme.desc: Una joven mujer es forzada a reflexionar sobre su primera relación cuando se muda por accidente al edificio de su novio.

programme.title: Un amor muy conveniente
programme.desc: Una joven artista desafía las expectativas de su familia al fingir un compromiso con un carismático desconocido.

programme.title: Un invierno en la playa
programme.desc: Un escritor aclamado, su exesposa y sus hijos adolescentes aceptan las complejidades del amor en el transcurso de un año. Protagonizada por Jennifer Connelly, Kristen Bell and Greg Kinnear.

programme.title: La belleza del amor
programme.desc: Emma ha creado un sitio web, pero cuando sus cifras empiezan a bajar, cree que podría haber encontrado su solución asociándose con una ambiciosa millennial llamada Jill que tiene sus propios sueños.

programme.title: Dreamer: Inspired By A True Story
programme.desc: Ben believes that an injured racehorse deserves another chance. He and his daughter adopt the horse and save it. The arrival of the mare to Crane's farm, will be the perfect opportunity for both father and daughter to bond.

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Biography of children's author Beatrix Potter, including how she overcame a domineering mother, and the chauvinism of Victorian England, to become a best-selling author.

programme.title: This Beautiful Fantastic

programme.title: Son of Rambow

Will Proudfoot (Bill Milner) is looking for an escape from his family’s stifling home life when he encounters Lee Carter (Will Poulter), the school bully. Armed with a video camera and a copy of Rambo: First Blood, Lee plans to make cinematic history by filming his own action-packed video epic. Together, these two newfound friends-turned-budding-filmmakers quickly discover that their imaginative – and sometimes mishap-filled – cinematic adventure has begun to take on a life of its own! Entertaining, uplifting, and brimming with nostalgia, Son of Rambow “makes you feel like a kid again” (Ethan Alter, Giant Magazine).

programme.title: Last Vegas

programme.title: Charlie Bartlett
programme.desc: Wealthy teenager Charlie Bartlett (Anton Yelchin) is failing miserably at fitting in at a new public high school run by the world-weary Principal Gardner (Robert Downey, Jr.).

programme.title: So Undercover

programme.title: Girl In Progress
programme.desc: As single mom Grace juggles work, bills, and her affair with a married doctor, her daughter, Ansiedad, plots a shortcut to adulthood after finding inspiration in the coming-of-age stories she's reading for school.

programme.desc: Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

programme.title: Paris, je t'aime

programme.title: New York I Love You

programme.title: Hello, Bookstore

programme.title: A Fish Tale

programme.title: Tad: The Lost Explorer

programme.desc: A rookie race car driver gets the opportunity of a lifetime to compete against the reigning rally car champion.

programme.title: Shark Bait

programme.title: Kensuke's Kingdom

programme.title: The Steam Engines of Oz
programme.desc: 100 years after Dorothy clicked her ruby red slippers to leave the magical land of oz, Victoria, a young engineer who keeps the city gears moving, joins the Scarecrow and a not so cowardly lion to once again help the Tin Man find his heart

programme.title: Postman Pat: The Movie
programme.desc: A veteran postman finds his beliefs challenged after he enters a TV talent show competition.

programme.title: Toys & Pets
programme.desc: A little toy with a wish and a robot from the future team up to find a fabled mystic and rescue their friend from the evil rat Flash. On this magical animated journey, they discover that teamwork and friendship will help them save the day.

programme.title: Captain Morten and the Spider Queen
programme.desc:
Ten-year-old Morten spends his days building a toy ship and trying to avoid the ire of his reluctant guardian – a mean ex-ballerina named Anna – while his father is at sea. Morten hopes to one day be a Captain just like him.
After a chance meeting wi...

programme.title: Up and Away

programme.title: Ice Dragon: Legend of the Blue Daisies

programme.title: Boonie Bears: The Wild Life

programme.title: Blinky Bill: The Movie

programme.title: Quackerz

programme.title: Kikoriki: Team Invincible

An army recruit is found dead at exactly 23:59. This mysterious and gruesome incident unearths a terrifying dark secret of the haunted island.

programme.title: Flight 7500

programme.title: Reefer Madness
programme.desc: This freaky musical is a parody of an actual, dead serious anti-marihuana propaganda film from 1936, trying to convince the American public that just one drag of pot forever and irrevocably turns average high school kids into hopeless drug addicts.

programme.title: Drama Drama
programme.desc: The most unlikely pairing of teen-age girls end up bonding to form the pop group Drama Drama, and make a stand against bullying in their high school.

programme.title: Valley Girl (2020)
programme.desc: In this musical adaptation of the hit 1983 film that changed American teenage life forever, Julie (Jessica Rothe) is the ultimate ‘80s Valley Girl, whose world is rocked when she falls hard for Randy (Josh Whitehouse), a punk rocker from Hollywood!

programme.title: Passing Strange
programme.desc: Director Spike Lee's passionate adaptation of the thrilling Broadway musical about a young bohemian who experiences sex, drugs, and rock and roll on his journey to selfhood.

programme.title: The Fantasticks
programme.desc: A charm-drenched period-piece musical based on the Broadway smash, "The Fantasticks" tells the story of a pair of potential young lovers (Jean Louisa Kelly, Joey McIntyre) whose romance is assisted/derailed by the machinations of their fathers.

programme.title: Hearts Beat Loud
programme.desc: A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.

programme.title: Romance & Cigarettes
programme.desc: Musical set in Bensonhurst, N.Y. In it, a two-timing husband must choose between his mistress and his beleaguered wife.

programme.title: To The Beat!
programme.desc: While twins Mia and Mackie form separate tap and jazz dance teams to compete against each other in a contest, their neighbor and nemesis, Avery, uses her charm and resources to get the upper hand in the competition.

programme.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
programme.desc: An epidemic of organ failures devastates the planet, and those who cannot afford their treatments are hunted by Repo Men in this unique production that modernizes the rock opera genre.

programme.title: Anna And The Apocalypse
programme.desc: In this gleeful mashup, Anna and her friends must fight – and sing – their way through a zombie invasion to reach the supposed safety of their school, not knowing if their parents and friends will still be alive when they get there.

programme.title: Lucky Stiff
programme.desc: Based on the hit Off-Broadway musical. A young, down-and-out British shoe salesman (Dominic Marsh) learns that he’s inherited $6 million from an American uncle. However, in order to get the money, he must take his uncle‘s corpse on a wild, parties-and-g...

programme.title: God Help the Girl
programme.desc: A feel-good comedy musical romance written and directed by Stuart Murdoch of Belle and Sebastian which tells the story of Eve (Emily Browning) who is low on self-esteem but high on fantasy, especially when it comes to music.

programme.title: Oklahoma! (1999)
programme.desc: Cowboy Curly McClain tries to win the heart of a girl in a singing and dancing extravaganza.

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, a couple turns all their fights into songs and starts a band with their neighbor.

programme.title: Hear Me Move (2016)
programme.desc: Muzi, the son of a famous street dancer tries to discover the truth about his father's tragic death 12 years prior. When he joins forces with his father's dance partner, he finds himself embroiled in a bitter rivalry that pushes him to his limit.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends: One And All
programme.desc: Following the success of their first album, the Fisherman's Friends struggle to adjust to their new-found fame and work towards a second album.

programme.title: Rise Up
programme.desc: Jamaica – the island that gave birth to the worldwide phenomenon of Reggae. In a society of plentiful talent but scarce opportunity, three distinct and courageous artists fight to rise up from obscurity and write themselves into the pages of history.

programme.title: Aria
programme.desc: 10 of the world's greatest directors were commissioned to create short pieces based on the world's greatest opera music. Erotic, demented, funny, poignant, extravagant, and outrageous, the result is breathtaking and totally unique.

programme.title: City Of Rock
programme.desc: In this zany musical comedy from acclaimed director Da Peng, a small-town musician plans a benefit concert to save his town’s beloved Rock Park from redevelopment by a corporate real estate agent.

programme.title: Poser
programme.desc: Local indie music podcaster Lennon Gates finds herself spiraling down a path of dark obsession when she befriends the striking performer Bobbi Kitten who coaxes her to find her voice. Lennon does..and creates an identity not wholly her own.

programme.title: Passage to Mars
programme.desc: Incredible true story of a NASA arctic expedition designed to be the first Martian road trip on Earth becomes an epic two-year odyssey of survival. Voiceover from Buzz Aldrin.

programme.title: Killer Asteroid
programme.desc: When natural disasters threaten, we turn to science and technology to warn us to seek shelter or get out of the way. But can they face down the ultimate threat: speeding projectiles from the depths of space?

programme.title: Birth of a Black Hole
programme.desc: It was one of the greatest mysteries in modern science: a series of brief but extremely bright flashes of ultra-high energy light coming from somewhere out in space. What can we learn from the violent birth of a black hole?

programme.title: One More Orbit
programme.desc: A daring team of astronauts and aviators fly a high-speed Gulfstream jet around the earth faster than anyone ever has to set the pole-to-pole circumnavigation record, breaking the boundaries of what was previously thought possible.

programme.title: Pale Red Dot
programme.desc: On the hunt for other solar systems, scientists have discovered an Earth-sized planet orbiting the star nearest to our Sun, Proxima Centauri. It's an important test of whether we are alone in the universe.

programme.title: Autonomy
programme.desc: Malcolm Gladwell leads a documentary about self-driving vehicles, asking us: what is control and who do we become as we relinquish it to machines?

programme.title: Flight of the Butterflies
programme.desc: Scientist Fred Urquhart studies migration of the monarch butterfly for 40 years.

programme.title: Jupiter Enigma
programme.desc: What can the giant planet Jupiter tell us about the birth of our solar system five billion years ago? Drawing on new findings from NASA’s Juno mission, scientists are peering into Jupiter’s stormy heart to reveal the very origins of our solar system.

programme.title: Maleika
programme.desc: Maleika, a cheetah mother and her six cubs, share their lives with director Matto Barfuss.

programme.title: Journey into Amazing Caves
programme.desc: Follow two accomplished female cavers as they descend deep inside treacherous and beautiful ice caves in Greenland, underwater labyrinths in Mexico's steamy Yucutan Peninsula and twisted caverns within the walls of the Grand Canyon.

programme.title: The Instrumental Chemist
programme.desc: The Instrumental Chemist features the remarkable life of chemist, inventor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Arnold O. Beckman. His brilliantly designed instruments enabled scientists to answer old questions faster and more accurately.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. It is the underpinning of the ecosystem, the foundation upon which the animals and plants of the north depend.

programme.title: Saving Jaws
programme.desc: Biologist OCEAN RAMSEY (“Shark Whisper") credits her connection with sharks to years of research, but others feel it’s something more. Join Ocean and a team of biologists as they travel the globe trying to halt their looming extinction.

programme.title: Miss Snake Charmer
programme.desc: Miss Snake Charmer contestants are not your typical high school beauty queens. The teens must show they are more than just pretty faces-that they have the guts and grit to win America's toughest beauty pageant.

programme.title: In the Mind of Plants
programme.desc: Can plants sense touch, feel pain, dream, and even remember? Some scientists are convinced plants have surpassed animals on their evolutionary paths.

programme.title: First to the Moon
programme.desc: In 1968, NASA sent three men farther and faster than anyone had gone before. This is the story of how Astronauts Frank Borman, Jim Lovell, and Bill Anders changed history on the flight of Apollo 8.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: The Nightmare
programme.desc: Five percent of the world's population have had the experience of awaking paralyzed while a supernatural entity climbs onto their chest suffocating them, inducing a level of fear that is beyond imagination.

programme.title: The Last Reef
programme.desc: The Last Reef is an uplifting, inspirational experience capturing one of nature's more vibrant and diverse wonderlands. These biodiversity hot spots are as vital to our lives as the rainforests.

programme.title: Juice: How Electricity Explains The World
programme.desc: Over a three-year period, we traveled 60,000 miles to interview 40 people from seven countries on five continents to tell the human story of electricity and explain why power equals power.

programme.title: New Life: Born to Run
programme.desc: In a land of dangers, plant-eating animals are always at risk, and never more so than at the time of their birth; out on the open they are vulnerable and there are few places to hide. But luckily some are born to run...

programme.title: Idaho The Movie
programme.desc: Idaho, the Movie is a one-hour television documentary featuring the well known and hidden treasures of Idaho. An elemental theme carries viewers on a tour of the state's mountains, rivers, deserts, landscapes, lakes and more.

programme.title: Climate Warriors
programme.desc: CLIMATE WARRIORS presents people who show resistance against the devastating effects of climate change. They show that we need a fast transition in order to save the environment and keep human rights in balance in favor of peace.

programme.title: The Cove
programme.desc: A team of activists, filmmakers, and freedivers expose a deadly secret hidden in a remote cove in Taiji, Japan.

programme.title: Fortress of the Bears
programme.desc: "Fortress of the Bears" enters a world shaped by bears, trees, and salmon, and explores the delicate balance of their interconnected lives.

programme.title: Elsa's Legacy: The Born Free Story
programme.desc: More than 50 years have passed since the publication of Born Free -- the book, and then a film, that changed forever the way we think about wildlife. What has happened to lions since this story?

programme.title: Superfish: Bluefin Tuna
programme.desc: Narrated by David Attenborough. It is a giant among fish, yet few have filmed it in the wild. Rick Rosenthal sets off to uncover the secrets of the legendary bluefin tuna, while documenting its place in the grand scheme of the vast marine ecosystem.

programme.title: To the Moon - From Dream to Reality
programme.desc: Between 1969 and 1972, twelve men walked on the surface of the moon. It was seen as the first chapter in the ambitious journey of space exploration.

programme.title: The Malaysian Snake Guardian
programme.desc: Not only snakes but the utmost wild creatures and exuberant jungle share life and planet earth.

programme.title: The Birds of Winter
programme.desc: Winter approaches Northern Europe and marks the beginning of the Great Journey.

programme.title: The Magic Forest of Spain
programme.desc: There is a magical place in central Spain, 80 kilometers away from Madrid, where everything is enveloped by an old forest.

programme.title: Red Sea
programme.desc: Explore the impressive underwater landscapes and fascinating species of one of the biggest wonders on our planet. Filmed in stunning 4K, this nautical journey features many of the sea creatures that have made the coral reefs their home.

programme.title: The Woman Who Loves Giraffes
programme.desc: In 1956, 23-year-old biologist Anne Innis Dagg made an unprecedented solo journey to South Africa to study giraffes in the wild.

programme.title: Saving Atlantis
programme.desc: Saving Atlantis focuses on the loss of coral reef ecosystems around the world, and the impact of that decline on the communities that depend on them, on a global journey that celebrates the majesty and mystery of coral habitats.

programme.title: Space Junk
programme.desc: After 50 years of launching our dreams into space, we're left with a troubling legacy: a growing ring of orbiting debris that casts a shadow over the future of space exploration.

programme.title: Avalanche: Man vs. Earth (2011)
programme.desc: Tumbling snow can be a massively destructive force, but is this destruction avoidable? With scientific understanding growing all the time, is it possible to gain the upper hand and control this awesome power of nature?

programme.title: Kilimanjaro: To the Roof of Africa
programme.desc: Join a band of trekkers as they journey through rugged terrain and extreme conditions to look out from Africa's highest point in David Breashears' mountain adventure, Kilimanjaro: To the Roof of Africa.

programme.title: New Life: Born to Swim
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface.

programme.title: Dolphins
programme.desc: Examines the lives of dolphins in beautiful tropical locales, their remarkable intelligence, and their relationships with some unique humans who are close to them.

programme.title: Wild Gibraltar
programme.desc: Wild Gibraltar is a wildlife feast featuring the varied and colourful animals which inhabit the border between Africa and Europe.

programme.title: Earth in 1000 Years
programme.desc: There are signs that Earth's great stores of ice on Greenland and Antarctica are starting to melt in the wake of rising sea temperatures. Scientists are looking back at past geological ages to understand the influence of ocean currents and other factors.

programme.title: Hurricane on the Bayou
programme.desc: Hurricane on the Bayou takes viewers on a breathtaking tour of one of the most vibrant places in America, the Louisiana bayou and the city of New Orleans, a place overflowing with life, music and natural beauty.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Magic in the Air
programme.desc: Hummingbirds, the tiniest of birds, qualify as some of the toughest and most energetic creatures in the world.

programme.title: The World From Above
programme.desc: Looking down on the world from above, one might see the incredible diversity of landscapes.

programme.title: Mystery of the Nile
programme.desc: On Christmas day of 2003, Pasquale Scaturro and a team of explorers set out on an epic quest to become the first to complete a full descent of the world's greatest river, the Blue Nile and the Nile, from source to sea.

programme.title: Mystery of the Northern Lights
programme.desc: Mystery of the Northern Lights explores the greatest mysteries of the aurora borealis. Using pioneering scientific experiments, experts uncover the secrets of this awe-inspiring phenomena.

programme.title: World's Smallest Woman: Meet Jyoti
programme.desc: Twenty-six-year-old Jyoti is the smallest woman in the world.

programme.title: Long Gone Wild
programme.desc: The killer whale is once again under siege, hunted for sale into the exploding marine theme park industry. An in-depth look at the case against captivity, the Whale Sanctuary Project, and covert missions in search of orcas held captive.

programme.title: Sharks: Monster of the Media
programme.desc: Dive into the world of sharks. Coined as monsters by the media, experience these behemoth majestic creatures in their natural habitat and learn about the threat of extinction to nearly one in four shark species and why they need our help.

programme.title: Welcome to the Cave of Wonders
programme.desc: A visual documentary that strives to show a glimpse into one of the most beautiful creations on earth from its unfathomable beginning millions of years ago to what it has become today.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Great Lakes
programme.desc: Through several interlocking stories, Mysteries of the Great Lakes will take you on a journey through the greatest lake system in the world, and showcase the amazing geography, ecology, science, and history of the region.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

programme.title: An Original DUCKumentary
programme.desc: There are 120 species of duck, but most of us don't know these creatures at all. Follow a wood duck family as a male and female create a bond, migrate together, nurture and protect their chicks, and head to their wintering grounds.

programme.title: Snow Monkeys
programme.desc: In the frigid valleys of Japan's Shiga Highlands, a troop of snow monkeys raise their families in a complex society where each knows their place.

programme.title: Siberian Tiger Quest
programme.desc: Chris Morgan has tracked large predators in some of the wildest and remote places on Earth. He now embarks on his greatest challenge - to find and film the Siberian tiger living wild and free in Russia's far Eastern forests.

programme.title: Bear-Like
programme.desc: Follow a bear-family in its struggle for survival in the harsh wilds of Alaska, witness tense scenes of conflict, and discover the untamed lives of these wild creatures.

programme.title: Island of the Penguins
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals, and their young overcrowd the beaches.

programme.title: Desert Kings
programme.desc: In ‘Desert Kings’ we follow the story of sub-adult Kalahari lions. This is a story of fighting for survival, death and hope. Who will survive the next two summers?

programme.title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Bees
programme.desc: The future of our food resources depends on the western honey bee. One third of our food supply depends directly on pollination from bees. This is the story of a worldwide ecological disaster that has been waiting to happen for several generations.

programme.title: Cyborgs: Human Machines
programme.desc: Technology has improved our lives in so many ways. Trans-humanists are fusing their bodies with digital implants to increase their abilities and expand their senses. How is life going to change for us all if some people have supernatural powers?

programme.title: Azure Dust: Inside Chernobyl's Exclusion Zone
programme.desc: The Exclusion Zone - a 1,000 square mile area around the site of the Ukraine 1986 nuclear power plant meltdown. Take a tour of the radiation zone and meet people who live and work in the shadow of the worst man-made environmental disaster in history.

programme.title: Wild Ocean
programme.desc: Plunge into an underwater feeding frenzy, an epic struggle for survival where whales, sharks, dolphins, seals, gannets and billions of fish collide with mankind during one of nature's greatest migration spectacles.

programme.title: To Be First: The Quest For Yangmolong
programme.desc: Follow a climbing expedition as they make three attempts to summit one of the last unclimbed peaks on earth.

programme.title: Fukushima: Robots in Hell
programme.desc: On the 11th of March 20t11, an earthquake and a tsunami led to to the most serious nuclear accident of the century. On the heels of explosions, radioactivity levels reached record highs.

programme.title: A Taste Of Whale
programme.desc: It is the 'Grind' season again - Faroe Islanders' ritual slaughter of pilot whales. Two proud whalers are on one side, two young and passionate Sea Shepherd activists on the other. A Taste of Whale invites you to see what meat-eating is truly about.

programme.title: It's Quieter in the Twilight
programme.desc: Fighting outdated technology and time, Voyager's flight-team pursues humankind's greatest exploration.

programme.title: Sharks, Scavengers of the Seas
programme.desc: Before being an earthly paradise with enchanting colours, the lagoon of New Caledonia is above all a paradise for sharks. But not just any sharks: they are used to being considered as fearsome predators, they are essentially opportunistic scavengers.

programme.title: Apollo 16: The Men, The Moon
programme.desc: After 25 years the untold human side of the Apollo 16 moon mission is now made available to the public, as the crew members finally reveal their riveting experience.

programme.title: Birth of Speed
programme.desc: Two mature and experienced Cheetahs are both raising cubs. The only difference is their age. ‘The Birth of Speed’ follows them on their challenge of raising cubs in this unexpected landscape.

programme.title: New Life: Born to Hunt
programme.desc: Baby animals beguile with their innocent charm. But while some remain harmless, others have a deep-rooted instinct. It may take weeks or months of training to hone their skills, but in every corner of the globe predators emerge.

programme.title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah. Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes. But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side.

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Six million metric tons of plastic wind up in the world's ocean every year. Unlike other refuse, plastic can stay in the water forever without breaking down. How is this deadly killer affecting the world's oceans, and how will it affect humanity?

programme.title: Sight: The Story Of Vision
programme.desc: An in depth look at the science, medicine, and technology of vision and individuals who are battling blindness. Narrated by Elton John.

programme.title: Oasis Earth
programme.desc: Ever imagine what it feels like to look at Earth from space? Join the crew of the space shuttle Endeavour and take a thrilling journey to experience the beauty in awesome High Definition of our planet from 150 miles above Earth.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Embark on a journey through the depths of the ocean, the beautiful savannah and the majestic forest to discover amazing creatures and the characteristics they have developed to evolve and adapt to their environment.

programme.title: Atlas of a Changing Earth
programme.desc: This award-winning MagellanTV original explores alarming changes to Earth's features and climate and reveals a vision of slowing environmental change.

programme.title: Leave it to Beavers
programme.desc: The fascinating story of beavers in North America - their history, near extinction, and current comeback, as conservationists regard beavers as overlooked tools when it comes to reversing the effects of global warming and water shortages.

programme.title: Malaria: The Serial Killer

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing

programme.desc: A group of friends reunites at their high school reunion, each with their own unbelievable story. Starring Channing Tatum (MAGIC MIKE, 21 JUMP STREET) and Rosario Dawson (SIN CITY).

programme.title: A Hologram For The King

programme.title: Day of Reckoning

programme.title: Super Bowl Champions - 2013 Seattle Seahawks

programme.title: Super Bowl Champions - 2012 Baltimore Ravens

programme.title: Super Bowl Champions - 2004 New England Patriots

programme.desc: Starring Shu Qi and Based on the #1 Bestselling novels, MOJIN: THE LOST LEGEND pits a trio of grave robbers against rivals and the law, until a mysterious stranger tempts them into one last heist. In Chinese with English Subtitles.

programme.title: Seven Swords: Bone of the Godmaker (2019)
programme.desc: In this action fantasy saga, a group of four swordsmen teams up to battle a powerful demonic force.

programme.title: Seven Swords: Eye of Shura (2019)
programme.desc: In this fantasy saga, a man battles against an ages-old evil demon that has long haunted his family.

programme.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon
programme.desc: In 1592, Korea is facing the threat of the powerful Japanese navy. As defending admiral Yin Sun-sin’s forces fall into crisis, they resort to a secret weapon—the dragon head ships known as geobukseon—to change the tide of the war.

programme.title: Memories of the Sword
programme.desc: While in medieval Korea, a young girl sets out to revenge for the betrayal and the death of her mother. But therefore she must face one of the most powerful men and warriors of the Goryo Dynasty.

programme.title: Sword of Destiny

programme.title: Code Of The Assassins
programme.desc: After completing his training, an elite young assassin embarks on his first mission and is quickly ensnared in an intricate plot by powerful people, forcing him to go on the run from the government and rival assassin groups alike.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Blades 2
